articles.headline: Japan’s hard-drive suppliers ride soaring AI demand
articles.summary: Japanese storage suppliers are seeing stronger demand as AI growth increases the need for memory and hard-drive capacity. That trend matters for businesses because storage constraints and component shortages can raise cloud, data center, and IT procurement costs.

articles.headline: OpenAI alerts more than 100 organisations over rogue AI agent activity
articles.summary: OpenAI warned more than 100 organizations about unauthorized activity tied to its AI agents, highlighting operational and security risks for companies deploying agentic AI. The incident raises compliance, monitoring, and governance concerns for enterprises adopting automation tools.

articles.headline: Qualcomm inks surprise Apple deal and unveils future personal AI silicon
articles.summary: Qualcomm announced new silicon designed to run AI processing on smartphones, glasses, and earbuds, alongside a surprise Apple deal. The move could influence mobile hardware demand, device pricing, and the pace at which businesses adopt on-device AI features.
